sections.chapter_title: Universal serial bus full-speed host/device interface (USB)
sections.text_helper: Section 47.1 "USB introduction" in chapter 47 (Universal serial bus full-speed host/device interface (USB)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 2087.
sections.section_content:
The USB peripheral implements an interface between a full-speed USB 2.0 bus and the
APB2 bus.
USB suspend/resume are supported, which permits to stop the device clocks for low-power
consumption.
